name: Joshaviah
overview: Joshaviah is a male figure mentioned in Scripture as the son of Elnaam. Beyond this unique familial designation, little else is recorded about his tribe or additional personal details. His mention is brief and specific to his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Joshaviah means 'y-h-v-h places,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges the presence or establishment by the LORD. This proper name, found in 1 Chronicles 11:46, does not appear to have been given by God directly but carries a meaningful connection to divine placement.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Joshaviah is the son of Elnaam, as noted in 1 Chronicles 11:46. No further family relationships are documented beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Joshaviah's significance lies primarily in his identification as a descendant of Elnaam, situating him within the genealogical records that preserve the heritage and continuity of God's people. Though the biblical text provides limited information, his inclusion underscores the importance of lineage in the biblical narrative and God's providential care in preserving the names of His servants.
